summary.text: Michael Greer is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Chris Rogers (D).
He is a member of the Del Norte County Unified School District school board, representing District 5, and works as an education specialist.

paragraphs.text: Michael Greer earned a bachelor's degree from Chico State University in 1999.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been a special education teacher, has lived in Del Norte County for six years, and was president of the Paradise Unified School District Board during the Camp Fire period.
His term on the Del Norte County Unified School District board, where he represents District 5, ends in 2026.
Greer advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary for Assembly District 2.

In the survey, he listed affordability, accountability and "achieveability" as his campaign themes, and called for lower energy costs, streamlined business regulations and tax structure, and changes to agricultural, forestry and wildfire policy.
